recent.text: Nuggets lead 65-52 at halftime in Memphis. Nikola Jokic with 14-5-4 on 7/10 FG, had it working from midrange. Cam Johnson adds 12-3-3, Christian Braun 10-4-3.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Jamal Murray picks up his third foul with 45 seconds left in the first half, and Tyus Jones will finish it up for him.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Follow that with a +3 from the second unit with Cam Johnson staggering for 3.5 minutes.
recent.author: Bennett Durando
recent.quoted_text: Nuggets were a bit smoother in the Jokic + bench minutes to finish the first quarter, a -1 in 2:54. Denver has one turnover and 10 points off Grizzlies' turnovers. That's good for a 35-24 lead.

recent.text: The Nuggets offered their starters a chance to rest in Houston. Jamal Murray was the first to speak up in the text chain. Others followed his lead. He felt a sense of urgency, knowing Denver’s place in the standings. Travel woes? Not an excuse to sit out: https://t.co/rzXzj2IfJ0
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: David Adelman after Nuggets fell to 5-4 tonight: "Jamal Murray has been incredible. If we're 7-3, you're talking about, like, wow, who's playing better (than Murray) at the guard position, I'd say outside of Luka. ... One of the best players in the league."
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Asked David Adelman about the process of figuring out how to use DeMar DeRozan off-ball and why Denver has felt comfortable with him in the corners despite him having never really been a spacer/3pt shooter. https://t.co/oyUS9fznza
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: The Nuggets played really hard and defended really well, which makes a 110-100 loss in Houston sting that much more. Jamal Murray played 39:12, Nikola Jokic 38:38.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Eight-second violation on Aaron Gordon bringing the ball up. Costly. Houston scores at the other end to push lead to 10 and Denver is running out of time despite an impressive effort.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Offensively, this has been a Jamal Murray carry job from beginning to end. Nobody else can get it going for the Nuggets, who trail 93-87 with 6:27 left.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Brutal. Christian Braun has an excellent defensive possession out of the timeout to force a turnover, pushes the pace, hits an open Murray in the corner... and the one Nugget who *has* been knocking down shots tonight misses one.
recent.author: Bennett Durando
recent.quoted_text: You could see Cam Johnson willing that shot to go in after it left his hands. On a night the Nuggets haven't been able to hit anything, they finally knock down two straight 3s (Jokic and Johnson) to get within 10 and force a Houston timeout.
